If nobody sees it, it is a diary

Design is how the thing feels in the hand. Video is how a stranger understands it in thirty seconds. Both are part of shipping. A paper site that reads clean is a design choice. A clip of you pointing at a 404 is a distribution choice. Neither is decoration you add “later” if later means never.

This house has two registers on purpose. Paper — cream, hairline, IBM Plex, Source Serif — for the rooms where you read. Ink — dark, full-bleed, toys — for Play. Bold and weird can live next to black and white. They should not live in the same paragraph.

How a lesson becomes a film

One claim. One screen. One mistake you actually made. The long cut goes to YouTube and the chapter slot. The short cut goes to X the same day. Do not film a course. Film a morning.

Imagine is for stills and posters when you need a picture that does not exist. It is not a replacement for pointing the camera at the dashboard.

How I actually do it

Send Reorder’s site is the paper I wanted this house to steal. Parallel 51 is the other temperature. The twenty films should look like a person at a desk, not like an academy. If Mojoko World is the splash energy — big, moving, a little unhinged — that belongs on the way in, not on chapter 07.

Where noobs get stuck

A month on a logo. A week on a trailer for an app that 404s. Or the opposite: shipping in silence because “the product should speak for itself.” It will not.

Film this

This chapter is the film about film. Show the two cuts. Show the chapter slot empty, then filled. Say the date out loud. Ugly is allowed.

Do this before chapter 17

  • Write the one sentence the first video will say.
  • Record a two-minute pass with the phone. Do not grade it.
  • Put the short cut on X. Put the long cut on YouTube when it exists.
  • Leave the stills for after the words work.

Next: Apple — when a website is not enough.
